title.zh: 卷三十八 本紀第三十八 寧宗二
title.raw: 卷三十八 本紀第三十八 寧宗二 Volume 38 Annals 38: Ningzong 2

sentences.zh: 嘉泰元年春正月戊午，申嚴福建科鹽之禁。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Jiatai, on the day wuwu of the first month, the prohibition on levied salt in Fujian was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the first year of Jiatai (1201), on the day wuwu, the government strictly reinforced the prohibition on levied salt in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，謝深甫等薦士三十有五人，詔籍名中書，以待選擢。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Xie Shenfu and others recommended thirty-five scholars; an edict ordered their names registered at the Secretariat, to await selection and promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Xie Shenfu and others recommended thirty-five literati; the court ordered their names entered in the Secretariat registers pending appointment.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命路鈐按閱諸州兵士，毋受饋遺及擅招軍。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, circuit commandants were ordered to inspect troops in the various prefectures; they were not to accept gifts or recruit soldiers on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, circuit commandants were ordered to review troops in the prefectures and forbidden to accept gifts or recruit soldiers without authorization.

sentences.zh: 違者置諸法。

translations.literal: Violators would be punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Violators were to be prosecuted under the penal code.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以葛邲配饗光宗廟庭。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Ge Yong was enshrined as a companion sacrifice in Emperor Guangzong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Ge Yong was granted co-worship in Guangzong's ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 丙子，金遣完顏充來弔祭。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Jin sent Wanyan Chong to perform mourning rites.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Jin court dispatched Wanyan Chong to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，詔求明曆之士，壬辰，開資善堂。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day wuzi, an edict sought experts in calendrical science; on the day renchen, the Zishan Hall was opened.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuzi, the throne issued an edict seeking calendrical experts; on renchen, the Hall for Cultivating Goodness was opened.

sentences.zh: 遣俞烈使金報謝。

translations.literal: Yu Lie was dispatched as envoy to Jin to return thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Lie was sent to the Jin court to convey thanks.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，監察御史施康年劾少傅、觀文殿大學士致仕周必大首倡偽學，私植黨與，詔降爲少保。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Supervising Censor Shi Kangnian impeached the retired Grand Mentor and Hanlin Scholar of the Guanwen Hall Zhou Bida for first advocating heterodox learning and privately building factions; an edict demoted him to Junior Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Supervising Censor Shi Kangnian charged the retired Grand Mentor Zhou Bida with having pioneered "false learning" and cultivated a private faction; the emperor demoted him to Junior Mentor.

sentences.zh: 修《光宗實錄》。

translations.literal: The Veritable Records of Emperor Guangzong were compiled.
translations.idiomatic: Work was begun on the Veritable Records of Guangzong.

sentences.zh: 乙未，續修《吏部七司法》。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the Seven Offices Law of the Ministry of Personnel was continued in compilation.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, compilation of the Ministry of Personnel's Seven Offices Code was resumed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，初置教官試于四川。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, instructional-official examinations were first established in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, examinations for instructional officials were introduced in Sichuan for the first time.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，雨土。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, a shower of dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，雨雹。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingyin, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingyin, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，復雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, hail fell again.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, hail fell again.

sentences.zh: 頒《慶元寬恤詔令》、《役法撮要》。

translations.literal: The Qingyuan Edicts on Clemency and the Digest of Corvée Law were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: The Qingyuan clemency edicts and a digest of corvée regulations were issued.

sentences.zh: 己巳，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, hail fell again.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，臨安大火，四日乃滅。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, a great fire broke out in Lin'an; it was not extinguished until four days had passed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, a great fire ravaged Lin'an and burned for four days before it was put out.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，詔有司振恤被災居民，死者給錢瘞之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day xinsi, an edict ordered the relevant offices to relieve and care for disaster-stricken residents; money was given to bury the dead.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinsi, the throne ordered officials to aid afflicted residents and provide burial funds for the dead.

sentences.zh: 壬午，下詔自責。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, an edict of self-reproach was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the emperor issued an edict of self-reproach.

sentences.zh: 詔樞密院核禁衛班直及諸軍營柵焚毀之數。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to verify the number of imperial guard shifts and military camps destroyed by fire.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to tally palace guard units and army encampments burned in the fire.

sentences.zh: 癸未，避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the emperor avoided the main hall and reduced his meals.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the emperor withdrew from the main hall and curtailed court banquets.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命臨安府察奸民縱火者，治以軍法。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Lin'an Prefecture was ordered to investigate evil persons who set fires; they were to be punished under military law.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Lin'an prefectural authorities were ordered to hunt down arsonists and punish them under military law.

sentences.zh: 內降錢十六萬緡，米六萬五千余石，振被災死亡之家。

translations.literal: From the inner court were released 160,000 strings of cash and more than 65,000 piculs of rice to relieve households afflicted by disaster and death.
translations.idiomatic: The palace released 160,000 strings of cash and over 65,000 piculs of grain to aid families stricken by the disaster.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，龍州蕃部寇邊，遣官軍討之。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, tribal peoples of Long Prefecture raided the border; government troops were dispatched to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, tribal forces from Long Prefecture raided the frontier, and regular troops were sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 詔以風俗侈靡，災後官軍營造，務遵法制。

translations.literal: An edict stated that because customs were extravagant and wasteful, after the disaster military construction by government troops must strictly follow regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Citing extravagant popular customs, an edict required that post-disaster construction by government troops adhere strictly to regulations.

sentences.zh: 內出銷金鋪翠，焚之通衢，禁民無或服用。

translations.literal: Gold-inlaid and kingfisher-feather ornaments were brought out from the inner court, burned in the public streets, and the people were forbidden to wear or use them.
translations.idiomatic: Gold-inlaid and kingfisher-feather ornaments from the palace were burned in the open streets, and the populace was forbidden to use them.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，御正殿，復膳。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the emperor attended the main hall and restored full meals.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the emperor returned to the main hall and restored full court banquets.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以潛邸爲開元宮。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the former princely residence was made into the Kaiyuan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Ningzong's former princely residence was converted into the Kaiyuan Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔文武臣無寓居州任厘務官，著爲令。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, an edict forbade civil and military officials serving as acting officials in prefectures where they resided; this was established as a regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, an edict barred civil and military officials from holding acting posts in prefectures where they were residing and codified the rule.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，以旱，禱於天地、宗廟、社稷，詔大理、三衙、臨安府、兩浙州縣決系囚。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day wuwu, because of drought, prayers were offered at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain; an edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commissions, Lin'an Prefecture, and the prefectures and counties of the two Zhe circuits to decide cases of detained prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuwu, owing to drought the court prayed at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain, and ordered judges in the capital and two Zhe circuits to review detained prisoners.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，釋諸路杖以下囚，除茶鹽賞錢。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, prisoners punished by beating or below were released on all circuits, and tea and salt reward payments were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, petty offenders throughout the empire were released and tea-salt reward levies were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命有司舉行寬恤之政十有六條。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the relevant offices were ordered to implement sixteen articles of clemency policy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, officials were ordered to carry out sixteen measures of clemency.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，監太平惠民局夏允中請用文彥博故事，以韓侂胄平章軍國重事。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Xia Yunzhong, supervisor of the Taiping Huimin Bureau, requested following the precedent of Wen Yanbo in appointing Han Tuozhou as Director of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Xia Yunzhong of the Taiping Huimin Bureau urged that Han Tuozhou be made Director of State Affairs on the model of Wen Yanbo.

sentences.zh: 韓侂胄上疏請致仕，不許。

translations.literal: Han Tuozhou submitted a memorial requesting retirement; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Han Tuozhou memorialized asking to retire, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 免允中官。

translations.literal: Yunzhong was removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Yunzhong was dismissed from his post.

sentences.zh: 丙子，雨。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，遣陳宗召賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinsi, Chen Zong was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinsi, Chen Zong was sent to the Jin court to congratulate the Jin emperor on his birthday.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Venus traversed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，何澹罷。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day yimao, He Dan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yimao, He Dan was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以旱，復禱於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, because of drought, prayers were again offered at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, prayers were again offered at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain because of the drought.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，釋大理、三衙、臨安府及諸路闕雨州縣杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, prisoners punished by beating or below in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commissions, Lin'an Prefecture, and prefectures and counties throughout the circuits lacking rain were released.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, petty offenders in the capital and drought-stricken prefectures and counties empire-wide were released.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以陳自強參知政事兼同知樞密院事，張釜簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Chen Ziqiang was made Vice Grand Councilor and concurrent Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Zhang Fu was made Deputy Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Chen Ziqiang was appointed Vice Grand Councilor and Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Zhang Fu Deputy Secretary of the same bureau.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，復振被火貧民。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, relief was again given to poor persons affected by fire.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, fire-stricken poor were again given relief.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以吳曦爲興州都統制兼知興州。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Wu Xi was made Commander-in-Chief of Xing Prefecture and concurrently prefect of Xing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Wu Xi was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Xing Prefecture and concurrently its prefect.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，減奏薦恩。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jimao, the privileges granted through memorial recommendations were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jimao, benefits granted through memorial recommendations were curtailed.

sentences.zh: 甲申，張釜罷，以陳自強兼知樞密院事，給事中張岩參知政事，右諫議大夫程松同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Zhang Fu was dismissed; Chen Ziqiang was made concurrent Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Zhang Yan of the Secretariat Chancellery was made Vice Grand Councilor, and Cheng Song, Right Remonstrance Councillor, was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Zhang Fu was dismissed; Chen Ziqiang became Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Zhang Yan Vice Grand Councilor, and Remonstrance Councillor Cheng Song Associate Director of the bureau.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，復詔侍從、台諫、兩省集議沿江八州行鐵錢利害。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, an edict again ordered attendants-in-waiting, censors and remonstrators, and officials of the two secretariats to assemble and deliberate on the advantages and disadvantages of using iron coin in the eight prefectures along the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the court again ordered senior officials to deliberate on the pros and cons of iron currency in the eight Yangzi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，遣朝臣二人決浙西圍田。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinhai, two court officials were dispatched to adjudicate polder fields in western Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinhai, two court officials were sent to settle disputes over polder reclamation in western Zhe.

sentences.zh: 己未，雨土。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣李景和使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Li Jinghe was dispatched as envoy to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Li Jinghe was sent to the Jin court for New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，令禮官纂集孝宗一朝典禮。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, ritual officials were ordered to compile the ceremonial regulations of Emperor Xiaozong's reign.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, ritual officials were directed to compile Xiaozong-era ceremonial statutes.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，詔免瑞慶節諸道入貢。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jiashen, an edict exempted all circuits from presenting tribute on the Ruiqing festival.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiashen, tribute from all circuits for the Ruiqing festival was remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，起居郎王容請以韓侂胄定策事蹟付史館，從之。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Attendance Secretary Wang Rong requested that Han Tuozhou's record of securing the succession be handed over to the Historiography Office; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Attendance Secretary Wang Rong asked that Han Tuozhou's role in securing the succession be submitted to the Historiography Office, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 甲午，金遣徒單懷忠來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Jin sent Tushan Huaizhong to congratulate the Ruiqing festival.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Jin court sent Tushan Huaizhong to offer greetings for the Ruiqing festival.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，編《光宗御集》。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Collected Writings of Emperor Guangzong were compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, compilation of Guangzong's imperial writings began.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，蠲潭州民舊輸黃河鐵纜錢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day gengshen, the people's former payment of Yellow River iron cable money in Tan Prefecture was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengshen, Tan Prefecture residents were exempted from the old levy for Yellow River iron cables.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，太白經天。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jimao, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jimao, Venus traversed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，復免臨安府民身丁錢三年，辛丑，雨土。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the poll tax on households in Lin'an Prefecture was again remitted for three years; on the day xinchou, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Lin'an household poll taxes were again waived for three years; on xinchou, dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，金遣紇石烈真來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Jin sent Heshenlie Zhen to congratulate the New Year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Jin court sent Heshenlie Zhen to offer New Year's greetings for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，浙西、江東、兩淮、利州路旱，振之，仍蠲其賦。

translations.literal: That year, western Zhe, eastern Jiang, the two Huai circuits, and Lizhou Circuit suffered drought; they were given relief, and their taxes were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year drought struck western Zhe, eastern Jiang, the two Huai circuits, and Lizhou; relief was granted and taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 真里富國獻馴象二。

translations.literal: Zhenlifuguo presented two tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenlifuguo offered two tame elephants as tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸亥，以知閣門事蘇師旦兼樞密都承旨。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year, on the day guihai of the first month, Su Shidan, Director of the Gate, was made concurrent Chief Controller of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the second year (1202), on guihai, Su Shidan, Director of the Gate, was also appointed Chief Controller of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，陳自強等上《高宗實錄》。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Chen Ziqiang and others presented the Veritable Records of Emperor Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Chen Ziqiang and others submitted the Veritable Records of Gaozong.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，追復趙汝愚資政殿學士。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiashen, Zhao Ruyu was posthumously restored as Academician of the Zizheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiashen, Zhao Ruyu was posthumously restored as Academician of the Zizheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，修《高宗正史》、《寶訓》。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the Standard History and Precious Instructions of Emperor Gaozong were compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, work began on Gaozong's Standard History and Precious Instructions.

sentences.zh: 戊子，頒《治縣十二事》以風厲縣令。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the Twelve Matters for Governing Counties was promulgated to encourage and admonish county magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the Twelve Matters for Governing Counties was issued to admonish county magistrates.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，禁行私史。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, private histories were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, unauthorized historical works were banned.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，詔宰執各舉可守邊郡者二三人。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day xinhai, an edict ordered each grand councilor to recommend two or three persons capable of defending border prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinhai, each grand councilor was ordered to recommend two or three men fit to hold border prefectures.

sentences.zh: 己未，初命諸路提刑以五月按部理囚。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, circuit judicial intendants were for the first time ordered to tour their circuits in the fifth month and adjudicate prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, circuit judicial intendants were for the first time required to conduct their annual circuit tour in the fifth month and review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔諸路帥臣、總領、監司舉任將帥者與本軍主帥列上之。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, an edict ordered circuit commanders, supply commissioners, and supervisory officials to list together with the army commander those they recommended for command positions.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, circuit commanders, supply commissioners, and supervisory officials were ordered to submit joint recommendations with army commanders for general officers.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，雨雹。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day gengyin, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengyin, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the first day jiachen, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, jiachen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賜禮部進士傅行簡以下四百九十有七人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, 497 Jinshi graduates including Fu Xingjian and below were granted passage and origin degrees in the Ministry of Rites examination.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, 497 men including Fu Xingjian passed the Ministry of Rites Jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，遣趙不艱賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingzi, Zhao Bujian was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingzi, Zhao Bujian was sent to the Jin court for the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 己卯，臨安火。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, a fire broke out in Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, fire broke out in Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 壬午，浚浙西運河。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the transport canal in western Zhe was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the transport canal in western Zhe was dredged.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，禁都民以火說相驚者。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the people of the capital were forbidden to alarm one another with talk of fire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, capital residents were forbidden to spread fire rumors that caused panic.

sentences.zh: 庚子，大雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, heavy hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, a heavy hailstorm fell.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，封子覿爲安定郡王。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinhai, the son Shi was enfeoffed as Prince of Anding Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinhai, the son Shi was created Prince of Anding Commandery.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以旱，釋諸路杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, because of drought, prisoners punished by beating or below on all circuits were released.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, owing to drought petty offenders throughout the empire were released.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命有司舉行寬恤之政七條。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the relevant offices were ordered to implement seven articles of clemency policy.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, officials were ordered to carry out seven clemency measures.

sentences.zh: 庚午，禱於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, prayers were offered at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the court prayed at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 復行寬恤四事。

translations.literal: Four further articles of clemency were implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Four additional clemency measures were enacted.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，以吏部尚書袁說友同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingzi, Yuan Shuiyou, Minister of Personnel, was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingzi, Minister of Personnel Yuan Shuiyou was appointed Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸未，建寶謨閣，以藏《光宗御集》。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the Baomo Pavilion was built to house the Collected Writings of Emperor Guangzong.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the Baomo Pavilion was erected to store Guangzong's imperial writings.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔作壽慈宮，請太皇太后還內。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, an edict ordered construction of the Shouci Palace to invite the Grand Empress Dowager to return to the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the throne ordered the Shouci Palace built to welcome the Grand Empress Dowager back to the inner quarters.

sentences.zh: 甲午，謝深甫等上《慶元條法事類》。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Xie Shenfu and others presented the Classified Statutes of the Qingyuan Period.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Xie Shenfu and others submitted the Classified Statutes of the Qingyuan Period.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，朝壽慈宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiyou, the emperor held court at the Shouci Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiyou, the emperor attended court at the Shouci Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，修《皇帝會要》。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the Imperial Compendium was compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, work began on the Imperial Compendium.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，奉安光宗皇帝、慈懿皇后神御于景靈宮、萬壽觀。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the spirit tablets of Emperor Guangzong and Empress Ciyi were installed in the Jingling Palace and the Wanshou Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the spirit portraits of Emperor Guangzong and Empress Ciyi were installed in the Jingling Palace and Wanshou Abbey.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，嗣秀王伯圭薨，追封崇王，諡曰憲靖。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the heir Prince of Xiu, Bo Gui, died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chong with the posthumous title Xianjing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Heir Prince of Xiu Bo Gui died and was posthumously created Prince of Chong with the temple name Xianjing.

sentences.zh: 庚午，臨安府野蠶成繭。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, wild silkworms in Lin'an Prefecture formed cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, wild silkworms in Lin'an Prefecture spun cocoons.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，上壽成惠慈太皇太后尊號曰壽成惠聖慈祐太皇太后。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day yihai, the honorific title Shoucheng Huisheng Ciyou Grand Empress Dowager was conferred upon the Grand Empress Dowager Shoucheng Huici.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yihai, the Grand Empress Dowager was given the honorific Shoucheng Huisheng Ciyou Grand Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 戊子，金遣完顏瑭來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Jin sent Wanyan Tang to congratulate the Ruiqing festival.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the Jin court sent Wanyan Tang to greet the Ruiqing festival.

sentences.zh: 乙未，遣魯使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Lu was dispatched as envoy to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Lu was sent to the Jin court for New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 是月，追復朱熹煥章閣待制致仕。

translations.literal: That month, Zhu Xi was posthumously restored as Attendant Gentleman of the Huanzhang Pavilion in retirement.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the retired Attendant Gentleman of the Huanzhang Pavilion Zhu Xi was posthumously restored to office.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，始御正殿。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jiachen, the emperor began to attend the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, the emperor resumed holding court in the main hall.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，重修《吏部七司法》。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Seven Offices Law of the Ministry of Personnel was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the Ministry of Personnel's Seven Offices Code was revised.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以陳自強知樞密院事，前同知樞密院事許及之參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Chen Ziqiang was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; the former Associate Director Xu Jizhi was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Chen Ziqiang became Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and former Associate Director Xu Jizhi Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，右文殿楹生芝。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, fungus grew on a pillar of the Youwen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, auspicious fungus appeared on a pillar of the Youwen Hall.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiaxu, a black spot appeared in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, a sunspot appeared.

sentences.zh: 率群臣奉上壽成惠聖慈祐太皇太后冊寶于壽慈宮。

translations.literal: Leading the officials, the emperor presented the seals and regalia of the Grand Empress Dowager Shoucheng Huisheng Ciyou at the Shouci Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Leading his officials, the emperor presented the seals and regalia to the Grand Empress Dowager at the Shouci Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲申，立貴妃楊氏爲皇后。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the noble consort of the Yang clan was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Noble Consort Lady Yang was elevated to empress.

sentences.zh: 加韓侂胄太師。

translations.literal: Han Tuozhou was advanced to Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Han Tuozhou was promoted to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大閱。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, a grand military review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the court held a grand military review.

sentences.zh: 是歲，建寧府、福、汀、南劍、瀘四州水，邵州旱，振之。

translations.literal: That year, Jianning Prefecture, Fu, Ting, Nanjian, and Lu Prefectures suffered flooding; Shaozhou suffered drought; relief was given.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods struck Jianning Prefecture, Fu, Ting, Nanjian, and Lu, while Shaozhou suffered drought; relief was granted.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚辰，謝深甫罷。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, on the day gengchen of the first month, Xie Shenfu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the third year (1203), on gengchen, Xie Shenfu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，置湖南溪洞總首。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, a general chieftain for the stream-cave peoples of Hunan was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, a chief coordinator for the Hunan tribal stream-cave districts was appointed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，龍州蕃部復寇邊，遣官軍討之。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, tribal peoples of Long Prefecture again raided the border; government troops were dispatched to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Long Prefecture tribes again raided the frontier, and regular troops were sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 甲午，張岩罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Zhang Yan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Zhang Yan was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以陳自強兼參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Chen Ziqiang was made concurrent Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Chen Ziqiang was also appointed Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，幸太學，謁大成殿，御化原堂，命國子祭酒李寅仲講《尚書•周官》篇。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the emperor visited the Imperial Academy, paid homage at the Dacheng Hall, attended at the Huayuan Hall, and ordered the National University Chancellor Li Yinzhong to lecture on the "Offices of Zhou" chapter of the Book of Documents.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the emperor visited the Imperial Academy, paid homage at Dacheng Hall, took his seat at Huayuan Hall, and had National University Chancellor Li Yinzhong lecture on the "Offices of Zhou" from the Book of Documents.

sentences.zh: 遂幸武學，謁武成殿。

translations.literal: He then visited the Military Academy and paid homage at the Wucheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He then visited the Military Academy and paid homage at Wucheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 監學官進秩一級，諸生推恩、賜帛有差。

translations.literal: Supervisory academy officials were advanced one rank; students received graded favors and gifts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Academy supervisors were promoted one rank, and students received gifts of favor and silk in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 以袁說友參知政事，權翰林學士、知制誥傅伯壽簽書樞密院事，伯壽辭不拜。

translations.literal: Yuan Shuiyou was made Vice Grand Councilor; the acting Hanlin Academician and Draft Edict Compiler Fu Boshou was made Deputy Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs, but Boshou declined to accept.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shuiyou was appointed Vice Grand Councilor; Acting Hanlin Academician Fu Boshou was offered Deputy Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs but declined the appointment.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，御文德殿冊皇后。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yisi, the emperor attended at the Wende Hall to enfeoff the empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yisi, the emperor conducted the empress-enfeoffment ceremony at Wende Hall.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書費士寅簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Fei Shiyin, Minister of Personnel, was made Deputy Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Fei Shiyin was appointed Deputy Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，以久雨，詔大理、三衙、臨安府決系囚。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingchou, because of prolonged rain, an edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commissions, and Lin'an Prefecture to decide cases of detained prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingchou, owing to prolonged rain the court ordered capital judges to review detained prisoners.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，幸聚景園。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the emperor visited the Jujing Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the emperor visited the Jujing Garden.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the first day jihai, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month of summer, jihai, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，福州瑞麥生。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, auspicious wheat grew in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, auspicious wheat appeared in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，出封樁庫兩淮交子一百萬，命轉運司收民間鐵錢。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, one million Huai circuits paper notes from the sealed reserve treasury were released; transport commissioners were ordered to collect iron coin from the populace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, one million paper notes from the two Huai reserve treasuries were issued, and transport commissioners were ordered to recall iron currency from the populace.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，陳自強等上《徽宗玉牒》、孝宗、光宗《實錄》。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Chen Ziqiang and others presented the Genealogical Record of Emperor Huizong and the Veritable Records of Emperors Xiaozong and Guangzong.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Chen Ziqiang and others submitted Huizong's genealogical record and the veritable records of Xiaozong and Guangzong.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔宰執、台諫子孫毋就試。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, an edict forbade the descendants of grand councilors and censors and remonstrators from taking examinations.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, descendants of grand councilors and censorial officials were barred from sitting for examinations.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，以陳自強爲右丞相，許及之知樞密院事，仍兼參知政事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day wuyin, Chen Ziqiang was made Right Grand Councilor; Xu Jizhi was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, still concurrently Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuyin, Chen Ziqiang became Right Grand Councilor, and Xu Jizhi Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs while retaining his post as Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以旱，詔大理、三衙、臨安府釋杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, because of drought, an edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commissions, and Lin'an Prefecture to release prisoners punished by beating or below.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, owing to drought petty offenders in the capital were released.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命有司搜訪舊聞，修三朝正史，以書來上者賞之。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the relevant offices were ordered to search out old reports and compile the standard histories of three reigns; those who submitted books would be rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, officials were ordered to gather historical materials and compile the standard histories of three reigns, with rewards for contributors.

sentences.zh: 是月，以蘇師旦爲定江軍承宣使。

translations.literal: That month, Su Shidan was made Commissioner of the Dingjiang Army.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Su Shidan was appointed Commissioner of the Dingjiang Army.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，遣劉甲賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renyin, Liu Jia was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renyin, Liu Jia was sent to the Jin court for the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 己酉，減大理、三衙、臨安府囚罪一等，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, crimes of prisoners in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commissions, and Lin'an Prefecture were reduced one degree, and those punished by beating or below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, sentences in the capital were reduced one degree and petty offenders released.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Venus traversed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，頒《慶元條法事類》。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinwei, the Classified Statutes of the Qingyuan Period were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, the Classified Statutes of the Qingyuan Period were issued.

sentences.zh: 命殿前司造戰艦。

translations.literal: The Palace Front Commission was ordered to build warships.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Front Commission was ordered to build warships.

sentences.zh: 壬午，權罷同安、漢陽、蘄春三監鑄錢。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, coin minting at the three supervisory offices of Tong'an, Hanyang, and Qichun was temporarily suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, minting at the Tong'an, Hanyang, and Qichun mints was temporarily suspended.

sentences.zh: 白虹貫日。

translations.literal: A white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: A white bow appeared across the sun.

sentences.zh: 癸未，禁江、浙州縣抑納逃賦。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Jiang and Zhe prefectures and counties were forbidden to forcibly collect escaped tax levies.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Jiang and Zhe prefectures were forbidden to coerce payment of evaded taxes.

sentences.zh: 乙未，加光宗皇帝諡曰循道憲仁明功茂德溫文順武聖哲慈孝皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Emperor Guangzong's posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Xundao Xianren Minggong Maode Wen Shunwu Shengche Cixiao.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Guangzong's posthumous title was extended to the full honorific Xundao Xianren Minggong Maode Wen Shunwu Shengche Cixiao.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，增置襄陽騎軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day renyin, cavalry forces at Xiangyang were increased.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renyin, Xiangyang cavalry was expanded.

sentences.zh: 戊申，置四川提舉茶馬二員，分治茶、馬事。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, two Sichuan tea-and-horse commissioners were established to separately administer tea and horse affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, two Sichuan tea-and-horse commissioners were appointed to administer tea and horses separately.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，陳自強等上《皇帝會要》。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Chen Ziqiang and others presented the Imperial Compendium.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Chen Ziqiang and others submitted the Imperial Compendium.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔刑部歲終比較諸路瘐死之數，以爲殿最。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, an edict ordered the Ministry of Justice at year's end to compare the number of deaths from illness in confinement on each circuit, using this as a measure of administrative merit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the Ministry of Justice was ordered to rank circuit officials by year-end tallies of deaths among prisoners held for illness.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，袁說友罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day gengwu, Yuan Shuiyou was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengwu, Yuan Shuiyou was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以宗子希璂爲莊文太子嗣，更名搢，授右千牛衛將軍。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the imperial clansman Xiqi was made heir to the Crown Prince Zhuangwen, renamed Jin, and appointed General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, imperial clansman Xiqi was named heir to Crown Prince Zhuangwen, given the name Jin, and appointed General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命坑冶鐵冶司毋得毀私錢改鑄。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the Mining and Iron Smelting Office was ordered not to destroy private coin to recoin it.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the smelting office was forbidden to melt down private coin for recoining.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔南郊加祀感生帝，太子、庶子星，宋星。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, an edict ordered additional sacrifices at the southern suburb to the Progenitor God, the Crown Prince Star, the Commoner Son Star, and the Song Star.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, additional southern-suburb sacrifices were ordered to the Progenitor God, the Crown Prince star, the Commoner Son star, and the Song star.

sentences.zh: 遣張孝曾使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: Zhang Xiaozeng was dispatched as envoy to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xiaozeng was sent to the Jin court for New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，詔宥呂祖泰。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day gengzi, an edict pardoned Lü Zutai.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengzi, Lü Zutai was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以費士寅參知政事，華文閣學士、知鎮江府張孝伯同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Fei Shiyin was made Vice Grand Councilor; Zhang Xiaobo, Academician of the Huawen Pavilion and prefect of Zhenjiang, was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Fei Shiyin became Vice Grand Councilor, and Huawen Academician Zhang Xiaobo Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命兩淮諸州以仲冬教閱民兵萬弩手。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the prefectures of the two Huai circuits were ordered to drill ten-thousand crossbow militia in mid-winter.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the two Huai circuits were ordered to drill militia crossbowmen in mid-winter.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大風。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, a great wind arose.

sentences.zh: 戊申，龍州蕃部出降。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the tribal peoples of Long Prefecture came out and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Long Prefecture tribes surrendered.

sentences.zh: 壬子，金遣完顏奕來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Jin sent Wanyan Yi to congratulate the Ruiqing festival.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Jin court sent Wanyan Yi for the Ruiqing festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，上光宗冊寶於太廟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renshen, Guangzong's seals and regalia were installed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renshen, Guangzong's seals and regalia were installed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，朝獻于景靈宮。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, court audience and offerings were held at the Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the emperor offered sacrifices at the Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，朝饗於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, court audience and feasting were held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the emperor feasted at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the Round Mound; a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the emperor sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 癸未，大風。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, a great wind arose.

sentences.zh: 己丑，安定郡王子覿薨。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the son Shi, Prince of Anding Commandery, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Prince Shi of Anding Commandery died.

sentences.zh: 更定選人薦舉改官法。

translations.literal: The law on candidates' promotion through memorial recommendation was revised.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations on promotion through memorial recommendation were revised.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，復置福田、居養院，命諸路提舉常平司主之。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Fukuden and Juyang hospices were re-established; circuit Ever-Normal Granary commissioners were ordered to supervise them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, charity and poor-relief hospices were re-established under circuit Ever-Normal Granary commissioners.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，命四川提舉茶馬通治茶馬事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day bingchen, the Sichuan tea-and-horse commissioner was ordered to administer tea and horse affairs together.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingchen, Sichuan tea-and-horse affairs were reunified under a single commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，下詔戒敕將帥掊克。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, an edict of admonition was issued warning generals against extortion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, an edict warned generals against extorting their troops.

sentences.zh: 金遣獨吉思忠來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Jin sent Dujisi Zhong to congratulate the New Year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin court sent Dujisi Zhong to offer New Year's greetings for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 是冬，金國多難，懼朝廷乘其隙，沿邊聚糧增戍，且禁襄陽榷場。

translations.literal: That winter, the Jin state suffered many troubles; fearing the court would take advantage of the opportunity, it gathered grain along the border, increased garrisons, and also banned the Xiangyang market.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Jin court, facing internal turmoil, feared Song would exploit its weakness; it stockpiled grain along the border, reinforced garrisons, and closed the Xiangyang trade market.

sentences.zh: 邊釁之開，蓋自此始。

translations.literal: The opening of border hostilities began from this point.
translations.idiomatic: Border conflict may be said to have begun here.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙亥，大風。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, on the day yihai of the first month, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fourth year (1204), on yihai, a great wind arose.

sentences.zh: 浚天長縣濠。

translations.literal: The moat of Tianchang County was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Tianchang County's moat was dredged.

sentences.zh: 癸未，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, a black spot appeared in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, a sunspot appeared.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 瓊州西浮洞逃軍作亂，寇掠文昌縣，遣兵討平之。

translations.literal: Deserting soldiers from Xifudong in Qiong Prefecture rebelled, raided Wenchang County, and troops were dispatched to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Deserters from Qiong Prefecture's Xifudong district rebelled and raided Wenchang County; troops were sent and the revolt was crushed.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，置莊文太子府小學教授。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dingyou, instructors for the primary school of the Crown Prince Zhuangwen's household were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingyou, primary instructors were appointed for Crown Prince Zhuangwen's household school.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命內外諸軍射鐵帖轉資。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, inner and outer armies were ordered to shoot at iron targets for advancement in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, all armies were ordered to qualify for promotion through iron-target archery.

sentences.zh: 壬子，蠲臨安府逋負酒稅。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, arrears of wine tax in Lin'an Prefecture were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Lin'an's outstanding wine taxes were waived.

sentences.zh: 己未，立《試刑法避親格》。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the Regulations on Avoiding Kin in Criminal Law Examinations was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, regulations on kin avoidance in criminal-law examinations were enacted.

sentences.zh: 庚申，夜有赤氣亙天。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, at night a red vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, a red glow filled the night sky.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，臨安大火，迫太廟，權奉神主于景靈宮。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingmao, a great fire broke out in Lin'an, threatening the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the spirit tablets were temporarily installed in the Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingmao, a great fire in Lin'an threatened the ancestral temple, and the spirit tablets were temporarily moved to the Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 己巳，避正殿。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the emperor avoided the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the emperor withdrew from the main hall.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命臨安府振焚室。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Lin'an Prefecture was ordered to relieve those whose dwellings had been burned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Lin'an was ordered to aid fire victims.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔修太廟。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, an edict ordered repair of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, repair of the ancestral temple was ordered.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，下詔罪己。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, an edict of self-blame was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the emperor issued an edict of self-blame.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔百官疏陳時政闕失。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, an edict ordered all officials to submit memorials stating failures in current governance.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, all officials were ordered to submit memorials on governmental shortcomings.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，復御正殿。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the emperor again attended the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the emperor returned to the main hall.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午朔，立韓世忠廟於鎮江府。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the first day jiawu, a temple to Han Shizhong was established in Zhenjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month of summer, jiawu, a temple to Han Shizhong was erected in Zhenjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 命內外諸軍詳度純隊法。

translations.literal: Inner and outer armies were ordered to examine thoroughly the Chundui military organization method.
translations.idiomatic: All armies were ordered to review the Chundui organizational regulations.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，許及之罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Xu Jizhi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Xu Jizhi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 振恤江西水旱州縣。

translations.literal: Jiangxi prefectures and counties afflicted by flood and drought were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: Flood- and drought-stricken prefectures and counties in Jiangxi were given relief.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以費士寅兼知樞密院事，張孝伯參知政事，吏部尚書錢象祖賜出身，同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Fei Shiyin was made concurrent Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Zhang Xiaobo was made Vice Grand Councilor; Qian Xiangzu, Minister of Personnel, was granted origin status and made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Fei Shiyin became Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Zhang Xiaobo Vice Grand Councilor, and Minister of Personnel Qian Xiangzu Associate Director of the bureau.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔革選舉之弊。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict ordered reform of abuses in the selection system.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, an edict ordered reform of examination abuses.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，詔諸軍主帥各舉部內將材三人，不如所舉者坐之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day yihai, an edict ordered each army commander to recommend three generals of talent within his command; if the recommendation was wrong, he would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yihai, each army commander was ordered to recommend three talented officers; false recommendations would be punished.

sentences.zh: 癸未，追封岳飛爲鄂王。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Yue Fei was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of E.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Yue Fei was posthumously created Prince of E.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，遣張嗣古賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day guisi, Zhang Sigu was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guisi, Zhang Sigu was sent to the Jin court for the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 丙申，置諸軍帳前雄校，以軍官子孫補之。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, valiant sergeants before the banners of all armies were established, filled from the descendants of military officers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, elite sergeants' posts in all armies were created for descendants of military officers.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔侍從、台諫、兩省集議裁抑濫賞。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, an edict ordered attendants-in-waiting, censors and remonstrators, and officials of the two secretariats to assemble and deliberate on curbing excessive rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, senior officials were ordered to deliberate on curbing excessive reward grants.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔諸路監司核實諸州樁積錢米。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, an edict ordered circuit supervisory officials to verify stored cash and grain in the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, circuit supervisors were ordered to audit prefectural grain and cash reserves.

sentences.zh: 沿江、四川軍帥簡練軍實。

translations.literal: Military commanders along the Yangzi and in Sichuan were to streamline and strengthen their forces.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzi and Sichuan commanders were ordered to streamline and strengthen their forces.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，增廬州強勇軍爲千人。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the Qiangyong Army of Luzhou was increased to one thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Luzhou's Qiangyong Army was expanded to one thousand men.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，以旱，詔大理、三衙、臨安府、兩浙及諸路決系囚。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day jiazi, because of drought, an edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commissions, Lin'an Prefecture, the two Zhe circuits, and all circuits to decide cases of detained prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiazi, owing to drought the court ordered judges in the capital, two Zhe circuits, and all circuits to review detained prisoners.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，禱於天地、宗廟，社稷。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, prayers were offered at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the court prayed at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命諸路提刑從宜斷疑獄。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, circuit judicial intendants were ordered to decide doubtful cases as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, circuit judicial intendants were authorized to decide doubtful cases at their discretion.

sentences.zh: 蠲內外諸軍逋負營運息錢。

translations.literal: Arrears of camp transport interest owed by inner and outer armies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Outstanding camp transport interest owed by all armies was waived.

sentences.zh: 辛未，蠲兩浙闕雨州縣逋租。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, arrears of rent in the two Zhe circuits' drought-stricken prefectures and counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, rent arrears in drought-stricken prefectures and counties of the two Zhe circuits were waived.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命諸路提刑、提舉司措置保伍法。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, circuit judicial intendants and supply commissioners were ordered to implement the baowu household-registration system.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, circuit judicial intendants and supply commissioners were ordered to implement the baowu household-registration system.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，陳自強等上《皇帝玉牒》。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jihai, Chen Ziqiang and others presented the Genealogical Record of the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jihai, Chen Ziqiang and others submitted the imperial genealogical record.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔自今以恩賞進秩，歲毋過二官。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, an edict ordered that from now on promotion in rank through favor grants should not exceed two ranks per year.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, an edict capped favor-grant promotions at two ranks per year.

sentences.zh: 蠲紹興府攢宮所在民身丁錢絹綿鹽。

translations.literal: Poll taxes in cash, silk, cotton, and salt on households in the area of the Shaoxing mausoleums were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Poll taxes in cash, silk, cotton, and salt on households near the Shaoxing imperial tombs were waived.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，除靜江府、昭州折布錢。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the cloth-tax conversion levy in Jingjiang Prefecture and Zhaozhou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the cloth-tax conversion levy in Jingjiang Prefecture and Zhaozhou was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊午，張孝伯罷。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Zhang Xiaobo was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Zhang Xiaobo was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，得四圭，有邸玉一，詔藏于太常。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yichou, four jade tablets were obtained, including one jade from the postal relay; an edict ordered them stored in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yichou, four jade tablets were obtained, including one relay-service jade; the court ordered them stored in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 壬午，遣鄧友龍使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Deng Youlong was dispatched as envoy to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Deng Youlong was sent to the Jin court for New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，戒飭兩淮州縣遵守寬恤舊法。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the two Huai prefectures and counties were admonished to observe the old clemency laws.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the two Huai circuits were admonished to uphold the old clemency statutes.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，以資政殿大學士、淮東安撫使張岩參知政事。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day gengzi, Zhang Yan, Grand Academician of the Zizheng Hall and Huaidong Pacification Commissioner, was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengzi, Zhang Yan, Grand Academician and Huaidong Pacification Commissioner, was appointed Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，金遣完顏昌來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Jin sent Wanyan Chang to congratulate the Ruiqing festival.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Jin court sent Wanyan Chang for the Ruiqing festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未朔，詔兩淮、荊襄諸州值荒歉奏請不及者，聽先發廩以聞。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day yiwei, an edict ordered that in the two Huai, Jing, and Xiang circuits, where famine made timely memorials impossible, granaries might be opened first and reported afterward.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, yiwei, the two Huai and Jing-Xiang circuits were authorized to open granaries first in famine emergencies and report afterward.

sentences.zh: 庚午，封伯栩爲安定郡王。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Bo Xu was enfeoffed as Prince of Anding Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Bo Xu was created Prince of Anding Commandery.

sentences.zh: 壬申，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, white vapor filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，修六合縣城。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the walls of Liuhe County were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the walls of Liuhe County were repaired.

sentences.zh: 開禧元年春正月癸酉，初置澉浦水軍。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Kaixi, on the day guiyou of the first month, the Ganpu naval force was first established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the first year of Kaixi (1205), on guiyou, the Ganpu naval force was established.

sentences.zh: 壬午，雨霾。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, rain haze fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, rain mixed with dust fell.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，奪徐安國三官。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day guisi, three ranks were stripped from Xu Anguo.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guisi, Xu Anguo was demoted three ranks.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔國用司立考核財賦之法。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, an edict ordered the State Revenue Office to establish methods for auditing finances and levies.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the State Revenue Office was ordered to establish fiscal audit procedures.

sentences.zh: 丙午，蠲臨安府逋負酒稅。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, arrears of wine tax in Lin'an Prefecture were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Lin'an's outstanding wine taxes were waived.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengshen, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengshen, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 辛未，申嚴民間生子棄殺之禁，仍令有司月給錢米收養。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the prohibition on abandoning or killing newborn children was strictly enforced, and the relevant offices were still ordered to provide monthly cash and grain for their care.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the ban on infant abandonment and infanticide was strictly enforced, and officials were ordered to provide monthly support for rescued infants.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以淮西安撫司所招軍爲強勇軍。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, troops recruited by the Huai'an Pacification Commission were made the Qiangyong Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, troops recruited by the Huai'an Pacification Commission were organized as the Qiangyong Army.

sentences.zh: 癸未，費土寅罷。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Fei Shiyin was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Fei Shiyin was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子朔，以錢象祖參知政事兼同知樞密院事，吏部尚書劉德秀簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the first day wuzi, Qian Xiangzu was made Vice Grand Councilor and concurrent Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Liu Dexiu, Minister of Personnel, was made Deputy Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month of summer, wuzi, Qian Xiangzu became Vice Grand Councilor and Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Minister of Personnel Liu Dexiu Deputy Secretary of the bureau.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以江陵副都統李奕爲鎮江都統，皇甫斌爲江陵副都統兼知襄陽府。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Li Yi, deputy commander-in-chief of Jiangling, was made commander-in-chief of Zhenjiang; Huangfu Bin was made deputy commander-in-chief of Jiangling and concurrently prefect of Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Jiangling Deputy Commander Li Yi became Zhenjiang Commander-in-Chief, and Huangfu Bin Jiangling Deputy Commander and concurrently Xiangyang Prefect.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，修《憲聖慈烈皇后聖德事蹟》。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the Sacred Virtues and Deeds of Empress Dowager Xiansheng Cilie were compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, compilation began on the Sacred Virtues and Deeds of Empress Dowager Xiansheng Cilie.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, a black spot appeared in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, a sunspot appeared.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，武學生華岳上書，諫朝廷不宜用兵，恐啟邊釁。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the military academy student Hua Yue submitted a memorial advising that the court should not use troops, lest border hostilities be provoked.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Military Academy student Hua Yue memorialized against going to war, warning that it would provoke border conflict.

sentences.zh: 以忤韓侂胄，送建寧府編管。

translations.literal: Because he offended Han Tuozhou, he was sent to Jianning Prefecture for registered confinement.
translations.idiomatic: Offending Han Tuozhou, he was sent to Jianning Prefecture for registered confinement.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大風。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, a great wind arose.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，賜禮部進士毛自知以下四百三十有三人及第、出身。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jisi, 433 Jinshi graduates including Mao Zizhi and below were granted passage and origin degrees in the Ministry of Rites examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jisi, 433 men including Mao Zizhi passed the Ministry of Rites Jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 復淳熙薦舉改官法。

translations.literal: The Chunxi law on promotion through memorial recommendation was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Chunxi regulations on promotion through memorial recommendation were restored.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔以衛國公曮爲皇子，進封榮王。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, an edict made Duke Yan of Weiguo the emperor's son and advanced his enfeoffment to Prince of Rong.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Duke Yan of Weiguo was adopted as the emperor's son and created Prince of Rong.

sentences.zh: 甲申，鎮江都統戚拱遣忠義人朱裕結弓手李全焚漣水縣。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Qi Gong, commander-in-chief of Zhenjiang, sent the loyalist Zhu Yu to join the bowman Li Quan in burning Lianshui County.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Zhenjiang Commander Qi Gong sent the loyalist Zhu Yu to join the bowman Li Quan in raiding Lianshui County.

sentences.zh: 是月，金國以邊民侵掠及增邊戍來責渝盟。

translations.literal: That month, the Jin state, citing border people's raids and increased frontier garrisons, came to reproach the court for violating the alliance.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Jin court, citing border raids and increased Song frontier garrisons, accused the Song of violating the alliance.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，罷廣東稅場八十一墟。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wuzi, eighty-one market tax stations in Guangdong were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuzi, eighty-one Guangdong market tax stations were abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔內外諸軍密爲行軍之計。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, an edict ordered inner and outer armies secretly to prepare for campaign marches.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, all armies were secretly ordered to prepare for campaign marches.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命諸路安撫司教閱禁軍。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, pacification commissions on all circuits were ordered to drill imperial guard troops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, circuit pacification commissions were ordered to drill imperial guard troops.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遣李壁賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Li Bi was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Li Bi was sent to the Jin court for the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 庚子，進程松資政殿大學士，爲四川制置使。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Cheng Song was advanced to Grand Academician of the Zizheng Hall and made Sichuan Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Cheng Song was promoted to Grand Academician and appointed Sichuan Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，淮東安撫鄭挺坐擅納北人牛真及劫漣水軍事敗，奪二官罷。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Zheng Ting, Huaidong Pacification Commissioner, was stripped of two ranks and dismissed for accepting a northerner named Niu Zhen without authorization and for the failed raid on Lianshui.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Huaidong Pacification Commissioner Zheng Ting was demoted two ranks and dismissed for harboring a northerner named Niu Zhen and for the failed Lianshui raid.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，天鳴有聲。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the sky sounded.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the sky thundered without visible clouds.

sentences.zh: 復同安、漢陽、蘄春三監。

translations.literal: The three mints of Tong'an, Hanyang, and Qichun were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Minting at Tong'an, Hanyang, and Qichun was restored.

sentences.zh: 己巳，熒惑犯太微右執法。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Mars encroached upon the Right Enforcer in the Supreme Palace constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Mars crossed the Right Enforcer in the Supreme Palace constellation.

sentences.zh: 陳自強等上《新修淳熙以後吏部七司法》。

translations.literal: Chen Ziqiang and others presented the Newly Revised Seven Offices Law of the Ministry of Personnel from the Chunxi Period Onward.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ziqiang and others submitted the newly revised Ministry of Personnel Seven Offices Code from the Chunxi period onward.

sentences.zh: 壬子，陳自強侍御史鄧友龍等請用本朝故事，以韓侂胄平章軍國事。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Chen Ziqiang, Supervising Censor Deng Youlong, and others requested following the precedent of this dynasty in appointing Han Tuozhou as Director of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Chen Ziqiang, Supervising Censor Deng Youlong, and others urged that Han Tuozhou be made Director of State Affairs on the model of earlier precedents.

sentences.zh: 減大理、三衙、臨安府囚罪一等，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: Crimes of prisoners in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commissions, and Lin'an Prefecture were reduced one degree, and those punished by beating or below were released.
translations.idiomatic: Sentences in the capital were reduced one degree and petty offenders released.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，詔韓侂胄平章軍國事，立班丞相上，三日一朝，赴都堂治事。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day gengshen, an edict made Han Tuozhou Director of State Affairs, with his place in court above the chief councilors, audience every three days, and attendance at the Secretariat to conduct affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengshen, Han Tuozhou was made Director of State Affairs, ranking above the chief councilors, holding audience every three days, and conducting affairs at the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 命興元都統司增招戰兵。

translations.literal: The Xingyuan Commandery-in-Chief's office was ordered to increase recruitment of combat troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Xingyuan headquarters was ordered to recruit more combat troops.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以蘇師旦爲安遠軍節度使，領閣門事。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Su Shidan was made Military Commissioner of the Anyuan Army and Director of the Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Su Shidan was appointed Military Commissioner of the Anyuan Army and Director of the Gate.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔侍從、兩省、台諫、在外待制、學士已上及內外文武官，各舉將帥邊守一二人。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, an edict ordered attendants-in-waiting, officials of the two secretariats, censors and remonstrators, waiting and academician officials inside and outside the court, and civil and military officials everywhere to each recommend one or two generals or frontier prefects.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, senior officials throughout the court and empire were each ordered to recommend one or two generals or frontier prefects.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，贈趙汝愚少保。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Zhao Ruyu was posthumously advanced to Junior Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Zhao Ruyu was posthumously promoted to Junior Mentor.

sentences.zh: 己卯，韓侂胄等上《高宗御集》。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Han Tuozhou and others presented the Collected Writings of Emperor Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Han Tuozhou and others submitted Gaozong's imperial writings.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔諸路提刑、提舉司措置保甲。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, an edict ordered circuit judicial intendants and supply commissioners to implement the baojia system.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, circuit judicial intendants and supply commissioners were ordered to implement the baojia system.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以韓侂胄兼國用使。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Han Tuozhou was made concurrent State Revenue Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Han Tuozhou was also appointed State Revenue Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以旱，詔大理、三衙、臨安府、兩浙州縣及諸路決系囚。

translations.literal: Because of drought, an edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commissions, Lin'an Prefecture, the two Zhe prefectures and counties, and all circuits to decide cases of detained prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: Owing to drought, the court ordered judges in the capital, two Zhe circuits, and all circuits to review detained prisoners.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌朔，蠲兩浙闕雨州縣贓賞錢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day bingxu, reward payments for apprehended criminals in the two Zhe drought-stricken prefectures and counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, bingxu, reward payments for apprehended criminals in drought-stricken two Zhe prefectures were waived.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命湖北安撫司增招神勁軍。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the Hubei Pacification Commission was ordered to increase recruitment of the Shenjin Army.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Hubei Pacification Commission was ordered to recruit more Shenjin troops.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，雨。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以殿前副都指揮使郭倪爲鎮江都統兼知揚州。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Guo Ni, deputy commander of the Palace Front, was made commander-in-chief of Zhenjiang and concurrently prefect of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Palace Front Deputy Commander Guo Ni became Zhenjiang Commander-in-Chief and concurrently Yangzhou Prefect.

sentences.zh: 是月，贈宇文虛中少保。

translations.literal: That month, Yuwen Xuzhong was posthumously advanced to Junior Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Yuwen Xuzhong was posthumously promoted to Junior Mentor.

sentences.zh: 追封劉光世爲鄜王。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi was posthumously created Prince of Bin.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊寅，韓侂胄等上《欽宗玉牒》、《憲聖慈烈皇后聖德事蹟》。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day wuyin, Han Tuozhou and others presented the Genealogical Record of Emperor Qinzong and the Sacred Virtues and Deeds of Empress Dowager Xiansheng Cilie.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on wuyin, Han Tuozhou and others submitted Qinzong's genealogical record and the Sacred Virtues and Deeds of Empress Dowager Xiansheng Cilie.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，劉德秀罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day dinghai, Liu Dexiu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dinghai, Liu Dexiu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔官吏犯贓追還所受如舊法。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, an edict ordered that officials guilty of corruption return what they had received, as under the old law.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, corrupt officials were ordered to return illicit gains under the old law.

sentences.zh: 丁未，遣陳景俊使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Chen Jingjun was dispatched as envoy to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Chen Jingjun was sent to the Jin court for New Year's greetings.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大風。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, a great wind arose.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，江州守臣陳鑄以歲旱圖獻瑞禾，詔奪一官。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jiazi, Chen Zhu, prefect of Jiang Prefecture, presented a diagram of auspicious grain because of the year's drought; an edict stripped him of one rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiazi, Jiang Prefect Chen Zhu presented a diagram of auspicious grain during a drought year; the court stripped him of one rank.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，升嘉定府爲嘉慶軍。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Jiading Prefecture was elevated to Jiaqing Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Jiading Prefecture was elevated to Jiaqing Army.

sentences.zh: 庚午，金遣紇石烈子仁來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Jin sent Heshenlie Ziren to congratulate the Ruiqing festival.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the Jin court sent Heshenlie Ziren for the Ruiqing festival.

sentences.zh: 復置和州馬監。

translations.literal: The Hezhou horse stud was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhou horse stud was restored.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，置殿前司神武軍五千人屯揚州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yiyou, five thousand Shenwu troops of the Palace Front were stationed at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiyou, five thousand Palace Front Shenwu troops were stationed at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，申嚴告訐之禁。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the prohibition on malicious denunciation was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, malicious denunciation was strictly forbidden.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑朔，修孝宗、光宗《御集》。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day guichou, the Collected Writings of Emperors Xiaozong and Guangzong were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, guichou, the imperial writings of Xiaozong and Guangzong were revised.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔兩淮京西監司、帥守講行寬恤之政。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, an edict ordered supervisory officials and commanders of the two Huai and Jingxi circuits to implement clemency policies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, supervisory officials and commanders of the two Huai and Jingxi circuits were ordered to implement clemency measures.

sentences.zh: 增刺馬軍司弩手。

translations.literal: Crossbowmen of the Cavalry Office were increased.
translations.idiomatic: The Cavalry Office crossbow corps was expanded.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔永除兩浙身丁錢絹。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, an edict permanently abolished the two Zhe poll taxes in cash and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the two Zhe poll taxes in cash and silk were permanently abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，金遣趙之傑來賀明年正旦，入見，禮甚倨。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Jin sent Zhao Zhijie to congratulate the New Year of the coming year; on entering audience his demeanor was very arrogant.
