translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Jin court sent Zhao Zhijie for New Year's greetings; at audience he was openly arrogant.

sentences.zh: 韓侂胄請帝還內，詔使人更以正旦朝見。

translations.literal: Han Tuozhou requested that the emperor return to the inner palace; an edict ordered the envoy to be received again at the New Year audience.
translations.idiomatic: Han Tuozhou asked the emperor to withdraw to the inner palace; the court ordered the envoy received again at the formal New Year audience.

sentences.zh: 著作郎朱質上書請斬金使，不報。

translations.literal: Compilation Officer Zhu Zhi submitted a memorial requesting execution of the Jin envoy; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: Compilation Officer Zhu Zhi memorialized asking that the Jin envoy be executed; the court did not respond.

sentences.zh: 是歲，真里富國獻瑞象。

translations.literal: That year, Zhenlifuguo presented an auspicious elephant.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhenlifuguo offered an auspicious elephant as tribute.

sentences.zh: 江浙、福建、二廣諸州旱，兩淮、京西、湖北諸州水，振之。

translations.literal: Jiangsu-Zhejiang, Fujian, and the two Guang circuits suffered drought; the two Huai, Jingxi, and Hubei circuits suffered flooding; relief was given.
translations.idiomatic: Drought struck Jiangsu-Zhejiang, Fujian, and the two Guang circuits, while floods hit the two Huai, Jingxi, and Hubei; relief was granted.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸未朔，蠲兩浙路身丁紬綿。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year, on the first day guiwei, the two Zhe circuit poll taxes in silk and cotton were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of spring in the second year, guiwei, the two Zhe poll taxes in silk and cotton were waived.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，再給軍士雪寒錢。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, cold-weather allowances were again given to soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, soldiers were again given cold-weather allowances.

sentences.zh: 發米振給貧民。

translations.literal: Grain was distributed to relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Grain was distributed to relieve the poor.

sentences.zh: 以金使悖慢，館伴使、副以下奪官有差。

translations.literal: Because the Jin envoy had been insolent, the chief and deputy hosts and those below were stripped of office in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Jin envoy had been insolent, the chief and deputy hosts and their staff were demoted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙未，增太學內舍生爲百二十人。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, inner students of the Imperial University were increased to one hundred twenty.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Imperial University inner students were increased to one hundred twenty.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，更名國用司曰國用參計所。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the State Revenue Office was renamed the State Revenue Accounting Office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the State Revenue Office was renamed the State Revenue Accounting Office.

sentences.zh: 己酉，雷雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, thunder, rain, and hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, thunder, rain, and hail fell.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔坑戶毀錢爲銅者不赦，仍籍其家，著爲令。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, an edict ordered that smelters who destroyed coin for copper would not be pardoned, their households registered, and this established as a regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, smelters who melted coin for copper were declared unpardonable, their households registered, and the rule codified.

sentences.zh: 是月，雅州蠻高吟師寇邊，遣官軍討之。

translations.literal: That month, the Yazhou tribal leader Gao Yinshi raided the border; government troops were dispatched to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yazhou tribal leader Gao Yinshi raided the frontier, and regular troops were sent to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，壽慈宮火。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day guichou, the Shouci Palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guichou, the Shouci Palace burned.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，太皇太后移居大內，車駕月四朝。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the Grand Empress Dowager moved to the Great Inner Palace; the emperor attended court four times a month.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Grand Empress Dowager moved to the Great Inner Palace, and the emperor attended court four times a month.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以火災，避正殿，徹樂。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, because of the fire disaster, the emperor avoided the main hall and suspended music.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, owing to the fire the emperor withdrew from the main hall and suspended court music.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以久雨，詔大理、三衙、臨安府及諸路決系囚。

translations.literal: Because of prolonged rain, an edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commissions, Lin'an Prefecture, and all circuits to decide cases of detained prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: Owing to prolonged rain, the court ordered judges in the capital and all circuits to review detained prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己卯，復御正殿。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the emperor again attended the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the emperor returned to the main hall.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，以程松爲四川宣撫使，吳曦爲宣撫副使。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guisi, Cheng Song was made Sichuan Pacification Commissioner and Wu Xi Deputy Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guisi, Cheng Song was appointed Sichuan Pacification Commissioner and Wu Xi Deputy Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲午，頒《開禧重修七司法》。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the Newly Revised Seven Offices Law of the Kaixi Period was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the newly revised Kaixi Seven Offices Code was issued.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔諸路監司歲十一月按部理囚，如五月之制。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, an edict ordered circuit supervisory officials in the eleventh month to tour their circuits and adjudicate prisoners, as in the fifth-month regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, circuit supervisors were ordered to conduct their November circuit tour and review prisoners, as in the May regulation.

sentences.zh: 己亥，從太皇太后幸聚景園。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the emperor accompanied the Grand Empress Dowager to the Jujing Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the emperor accompanied the Grand Empress Dowager to the Jujing Garden.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，錢象祖罷，以張岩兼知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Qian Xiangzu was dismissed; Zhang Yan was made concurrent Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Qian Xiangzu was dismissed, and Zhang Yan became Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以錢象祖懷奸避事，奪二官、信州居住，己酉，知處州徐邦憲入見，請立太子，因以肆赦弭兵，侍御史徐柟劾罷之。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, because Qian Xiangzu harbored treachery and shirked duties, two ranks were stripped from him and he was made to reside in Xin Prefecture; on the day jiyou, Xu Bangxian of Chuzhou Prefecture entered audience and requested establishment of a crown prince, proposing a general amnesty to halt hostilities; Supervising Censor Xu Kan impeached and dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Qian Xiangzu was demoted two ranks and exiled to Xin Prefecture for treachery and dereliction; on jiyou, Chuzhou Prefect Xu Bangxian memorialized to establish a crown prince and grant amnesty to stop the war; Supervising Censor Xu Kan impeached and dismissed him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，雅州蠻作亂，焚碉門砦，官軍失利。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jiwei, the Yazhou tribes rebelled, burned Diaomen Stockade, and government troops were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiwei, Yazhou tribes rebelled, burned Diaomen Stockade, and government troops were defeated.

sentences.zh: 庚申，四川宣撫司復調御前大軍往討之。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the Sichuan Pacification Commission again mobilized imperial guard troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Sichuan Pacification Commission again mobilized imperial guard troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以薛叔似爲兵部尚書、湖北京西宣撫使，鄧友龍爲御史中丞、兩淮宣撫使。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Xue Shusi was made Minister of War and Hubei-Jingxi Pacification Commissioner; Deng Youlong was made Censor-in-Chief and Two Huai Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Xue Shusi was appointed Minister of War and Hubei-Jingxi Pacification Commissioner, and Deng Youlong Censor-in-Chief and Two Huai Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 下納粟補官之令。

translations.literal: An edict on purchasing office through grain contribution was issued.
translations.idiomatic: An edict allowing purchase of office through grain contribution was issued.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以吳曦兼陝西、河東路招撫使。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Wu Xi was made concurrent Pacification Commissioner of Shaanxi and Hedong circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Wu Xi was also appointed Pacification Commissioner of Shaanxi and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 己巳，調三衙兵增戍淮東。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, troops of the Three Commissions were mobilized to reinforce Huaidong.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Three Commission troops were mobilized to reinforce Huaidong.

sentences.zh: 庚午，追奪秦檜王爵，命禮官改諡。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Qin Hui's princely title was posthumously revoked and ritual officials were ordered to change his posthumous name.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Qin Hui's princely title was posthumously revoked and ritual officials ordered to change his posthumous name.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以郭倪兼山東、京東路招撫使，鄂州都統趙淳兼京西北路招撫使，皇甫斌兼京西北路招撫副使，丁丑，吳曦遣其客姚淮源獻關外四州于金，求封蜀王。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Guo Ni was made concurrent Pacification Commissioner of Shandong and Jingdong circuits; Zhao Chun, commander-in-chief of E Prefecture, was made concurrent Pacification Commissioner of Jingxi North circuit; Huangfu Bin was made Deputy Pacification Commissioner of Jingxi North circuit; on the day dingchou, Wu Xi sent his client Yao Huaiyuan to present the four prefectures beyond the passes to Jin and request enfeoffment as Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Guo Ni became Pacification Commissioner of Shandong and Jingdong, E Prefecture Commander Zhao Chun Pacification Commissioner of Jingxi North, and Huangfu Bin his deputy; on dingchou, Wu Xi sent his client Yao Huaiyuan to offer the four frontier prefectures to Jin and request the title Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 鎮江都統制陳孝慶復泗州，江州統制許進復新息縣。

translations.literal: Chen Xiaoqing, commander-in-chief of Zhenjiang, recovered Sizhou; Xu Jin, commander of Jiang Prefecture, recovered Xinxin County.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenjiang Commander Chen Xiaoqing recovered Sizhou, and Jiang Prefecture Commander Xu Jin recovered Xinxin County.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，光州忠義人孫成復褒信縣。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Sun Cheng, a loyalist of Guang Prefecture, recovered Baoxin County.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Guang Prefecture loyalist Sun Cheng recovered Baoxin County.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，王大節除名、袁州安置，尋徙封州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renzi, Wang Dajie was removed from the registers and exiled to Yuan Prefecture; he was soon moved to Feng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi, Wang Dajie was struck from the registers and exiled to Yuan Prefecture, then moved to Feng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，建康都統李爽攻壽州，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Li Shuang of Jiankang attacked Shou Prefecture and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Jiankang Commander Li Shuang attacked Shou Prefecture and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，鄧友龍罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Deng Youlong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Deng Youlong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以江南東路安撫使丘崈爲刑部尚書、兩淮宣撫使。

translations.literal: Qiu Jun, Jiangdong East Circuit Pacification Commissioner, was made Minister of Justice and Two Huai Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangdong East Pacification Commissioner Qiu Jun was appointed Minister of Justice and Two Huai Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，雅州蠻高吟師出降，官軍殺之。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the Yazhou tribal leader Gao Yinshi came out and surrendered; government troops killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Yazhou tribal leader Gao Yinshi surrendered and was killed by government troops.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，減大理、三衙、臨安府囚罪一等，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, crimes of prisoners in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commissions, and Lin'an Prefecture were reduced one degree, and those punished by beating or below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, sentences in the capital were reduced one degree and petty offenders released.

sentences.zh: 奪郭倬、李汝翼二官。

translations.literal: Two ranks were stripped from Guo Zhuo and Li Ruyi.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhuo and Li Ruyi were each demoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，奪皇甫斌三官。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, three ranks were stripped from Huangfu Bin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Huangfu Bin was demoted three ranks.

sentences.zh: 甲子，李爽罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Li Shuang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Li Shuang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，曲赦泗州，減雜犯死罪囚，餘皆除之，蠲其租稅三年。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Sizhou, reducing capital crimes among miscellaneous offenders and releasing the rest, and its rents and taxes were remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Sizhou, capital sentences among miscellaneous offenders were commuted, the rest were released, and rents and taxes were waived for three years.

sentences.zh: 建康副都統田琳復壽春府。

translations.literal: Tian Lin, deputy commander-in-chief of Jiankang, recovered Shouchun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jiankang Deputy Commander Tian Lin recovered Shouchun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，雅州蠻復寇邊。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the Yazhou tribes again raided the border.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yazhou tribes again raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，奪李爽三官、汀州居住。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, three ranks were stripped from Li Shuang and he was made to reside in Ting Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Li Shuang was demoted three ranks and exiled to Ting Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 再奪皇甫斌五官、南安軍安置。

translations.literal: Five more ranks were stripped from Huangfu Bin and he was exiled to Nan'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Bin was demoted five more ranks and exiled to Nan'an Army.

sentences.zh: 丙子，奪鄧友龍三官、興化軍居住，戊寅，蘇師旦罷。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, three ranks were stripped from Deng Youlong and he was made to reside in Xinghua Army; on the day wuyin, Su Shidan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Deng Youlong was demoted three ranks and exiled to Xinghua Army; on wuyin, Su Shidan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 是月，命丘崈至揚州部署諸將，悉三衙江上軍分守江、淮要害。

translations.literal: That month, Qiu Jun was ordered to go to Yangzhou to deploy the generals, and all Yangzi troops of the Three Commissions were divided to guard the vital points of the Yangzi and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qiu Jun was ordered to Yangzhou to deploy generals, and all Yangzi troops of the Three Commissions were assigned to guard vital Yangzi and Huai positions.

sentences.zh: 金人封吳曦爲蜀王。

translations.literal: The Jin people enfeoffed Wu Xi as Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin court enfeoffed Wu Xi as Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，復紹興邊郡賞。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinsi, frontier rewards in Shaoxing were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinsi, Shaoxing frontier rewards were restored.

sentences.zh: 奪蘇師旦三官、衡州居住，仍籍其家。

translations.literal: Three ranks were stripped from Su Shidan and he was made to reside in Heng Prefecture; his household property was still registered.
translations.idiomatic: Su Shidan was demoted three ranks, exiled to Heng Prefecture, and his property registered.

sentences.zh: 罷旱傷州軍比較租賦一年。

translations.literal: Comparison of rent and tax for one year in drought- and disaster-stricken prefectures and armies was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Rent and tax comparisons for drought- and disaster-stricken prefectures were suspended for one year.

sentences.zh: 詔侍從、台諫、兩省、卿監、郎官、監司、郡守、前宰執侍從、各舉人材二三人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered attendants-in-waiting, censors and remonstrators, officials of the two secretariats, ministers and directors, bureau directors, circuit commissioners, prefects, and former chief councilors and attendants each to recommend two or three persons of talent.
translations.idiomatic: Senior officials throughout the court and empire were each ordered to recommend two or three talented men.

sentences.zh: 壬午，雅州蠻出降，庚子，蘇師旦除名、韶州安置。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the Yazhou tribes came out and surrendered; on the day gengzi, Su Shidan was removed from the registers and exiled to Shao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Yazhou tribes surrendered; on gengzi, Su Shidan was struck from the registers and exiled to Shao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以張岩知樞密院事，禮部尚書李壁參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Zhang Yan was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Li Bi, Minister of Rites, Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Zhang Yan became Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Minister of Rites Li Bi Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，置沂王府小學教授。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, instructors for the primary school of the Prince of Qi's household were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, primary instructors were appointed for the Prince of Qi's household school.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，有司上《開禧刑名斷例》。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingyin, the relevant offices presented the Kaixi Precedents on Criminal Names and Adjudicated Cases.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingyin, officials submitted the Kaixi Precedents on Criminal Names and Adjudicated Cases.

sentences.zh: 斬郭倬丁鎮江。

translations.literal: Guo Zhuo was beheaded at Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhuo was beheaded at Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，再奪李爽三官、南雄州安置。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, three more ranks were stripped from Li Shuang and he was exiled to Nanxiong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Li Shuang was demoted three more ranks and exiled to Nanxiong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔諸州無證有佐之獄毋奏裁。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, an edict ordered that cases without evidence but with accomplices in the various prefectures should not be submitted for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, prefectures were forbidden to submit for imperial decision cases lacking evidence but with accomplices.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以淮東安撫司所招軍爲御前強勇軍。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, troops recruited by the Huaidong Pacification Commission were made the imperial guard Qiangyong Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, troops recruited by the Huaidong Pacification Commission were made the imperial guard Qiangyong Army.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，金兵攻奪和尚原。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renwu, Jin troops attacked and seized Heshang Plain.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renwu, Jin troops seized Heshang Plain.

sentences.zh: 己丑，朝獻于景靈宮。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, court audience and offerings were held at the Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the emperor offered sacrifices at the Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，朝饗於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, court audience and feasting were held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the emperor feasted at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，合祭天地於明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the Bright Hall; a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the emperor jointly sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Bright Hall and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賞復泗州功。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, rewards were given for recovering Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, rewards were granted for recovering Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申朔，詔內外軍帥各舉智勇可將帥者二人。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day wushen, an edict ordered military commanders inside and outside the court each to recommend two persons of wisdom and courage fit to be generals.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, wushen, each military commander was ordered to recommend two wise and courageous men fit for command.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以將士暴露，罷瑞慶節宴。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, because soldiers were exposed to hardship, the Ruiqing festival banquet was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Ruiqing festival banquet was canceled because soldiers were suffering in the field.

sentences.zh: 丙子，金人自清河口渡淮，遂圍楚州。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Jin troops crossed the Huai from Qinghe Estuary and then besieged Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Jin troops crossed the Huai at Qinghe Estuary and besieged Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，命主管殿前司公事郭杲領兵駐真州以援兩淮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day gengchen, Guo Gao, chief of the Palace Front office, was ordered to lead troops to garrison Zhen Prefecture to aid the two Huai circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengchen, Palace Front chief Guo Gao was ordered to garrison Zhen Prefecture to aid the two Huai circuits.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，金人破棗陽軍。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Jin troops broke Zaoyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Jin troops captured Zaoyang Army.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以丘崈簽書樞密院事，督視江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Qiu Jun was made Deputy Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs and ordered to supervise Jiang and Huai military forces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Qiu Jun was appointed Deputy Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs and ordered to supervise Jiang and Huai forces.

sentences.zh: 金人犯神馬坡，江陵副都統魏友諒突圍趨襄陽。

translations.literal: Jin troops attacked Shenma Slope; Wei Youliang, deputy commander-in-chief of Jiangling, broke through and rushed to Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Jin troops attacked Shenma Slope; Jiangling Deputy Commander Wei Youliang broke through and fled to Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，趙淳焚樊城。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Zhao Chun burned Fancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Zhao Chun burned Fancheng.

sentences.zh: 戊子，金人犯廬州，田琳拒退之。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Jin troops attacked Luzhou; Tian Lin repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Jin troops attacked Luzhou; Tian Lin repelled them.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以金人犯淮告于天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the Jin attack on the Huai was reported to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the Jin invasion of the Huai was reported to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 乙未，避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the emperor avoided the main hall and reduced his meals.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the emperor withdrew from the main hall and curtailed court banquets.

sentences.zh: 以湖廣總領陳謙爲湖北、京西宣撫副使。

translations.literal: Chen Qian, chief commissioner of Huguang, was made Deputy Pacification Commissioner of Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang Chief Commissioner Chen Qian was appointed Deputy Pacification Commissioner of Hubei and Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 丙申，金人去廬州。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Jin troops withdrew from Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Jin troops withdrew from Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，金人犯舊岷州，守將王喜遁去。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Jin troops attacked old Min Prefecture; the defending commander Wang Xi fled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Jin troops attacked old Min Prefecture; Defender Wang Xi fled.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，金人圍和州，守將周虎拒之。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Jin troops besieged He Prefecture; the defending commander Zhou Hu resisted them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Jin troops besieged He Prefecture; Defender Zhou Hu resisted them.

sentences.zh: 金人破信陽軍。

translations.literal: Jin troops broke Xinyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: Jin troops captured Xinyang Army.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，金人圍襄陽。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Jin troops besieged Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Jin troops besieged Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，金人破隨州。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Jin troops broke Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Jin troops captured Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太皇太后賜錢一百萬緡犒賞軍士。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Grand Empress Dowager bestowed 1,000,000 strings of cash to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the Grand Empress Dowager granted 1,000,000 strings of cash to reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 詔諸路招填禁軍以待調遣。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all circuits to recruit and fill imperial guard ranks pending deployment.
translations.idiomatic: All circuits were ordered to recruit and fill imperial guard ranks pending deployment.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，金人犯真州。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Jin troops attacked Zhen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Jin troops attacked Zhen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，金人破西和州。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Jin troops broke Xihe Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Jin troops captured Xihe Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是月，濠州、安豐軍及邊屯皆爲金人所破。

translations.literal: That month, Haozhou, Anfeng Army, and frontier garrisons were all broken by the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: That month Haozhou, Anfeng Army, and frontier garrisons all fell to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，金人圍德安府，守將李師尹拒之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wushen, Jin troops besieged De'an Prefecture; the defending commander Li Shiyin resisted them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wushen, Jin troops besieged De'an Prefecture; Defender Li Shiyin resisted them.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，金人破成州，守臣辛槱之遁去。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Jin troops broke Cheng Prefecture; the prefect Xin Suozhi fled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Jin troops captured Cheng Prefecture; Prefect Xin Suozhi fled.

sentences.zh: 吳曦焚河池縣，退屯青野原。

translations.literal: Wu Xi burned Hechi County and withdrew to camp at Qingye Plain.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xi burned Hechi County and withdrew to Qingye Plain.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，釋大理、三衙、臨安府杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, prisoners punished by beating or below in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commissions, and Lin'an Prefecture were released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, petty offenders in the capital were released.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，金人去和州。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Jin troops withdrew from He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Jin troops withdrew from He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，金人攻六合縣，郭倪遣前軍統制郭僎救之，遇於胥浦橋，大敗，倪棄揚州走。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Jin troops attacked Liuhe County; Guo Ni sent Front Army Commander Guo Yan to rescue them; they met at Xupu Bridge and were greatly defeated; Ni abandoned Yangzhou and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Jin troops attacked Liuhe County; Guo Ni sent Front Army Commander Guo Yan to the rescue; they met at Xupu Bridge and were routed; Ni abandoned Yangzhou and fled.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，金人破大散關。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Jin troops broke Dasan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Jin troops captured Dasan Pass.

sentences.zh: 戊午，熒惑守太微。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Mars guarded the Supreme Palace constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Mars stood in the Supreme Palace constellation.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，魏友諒軍潰於花泉，走江陵。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Wei Youliang's army collapsed at Huaquan and fled to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Wei Youliang's army collapsed at Huaquan and fled to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，金人犯七方關，興州中軍正將李好義拒卻之。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Jin troops attacked Qifang Pass; Li Haoyi, company commander of the Xingzhou central army, repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Jin troops attacked Qifang Pass; Xingzhou Company Commander Li Haoyi repelled them.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，吳曦還興州。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Wu Xi returned to Xing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Wu Xi returned to Xing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 金人自淮南退師，留一軍據濠州。

translations.literal: Jin troops withdrew from Huainan, leaving one army to hold Haozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jin troops withdrew from Huainan, leaving one army to hold Haozhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，罷郭倪，奪三官，責授果州團練副使、南康軍安置。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Guo Ni was dismissed; three ranks were stripped from him and he was demoted to Training Vice Commissioner of Guo Prefecture and exiled to Nankang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Guo Ni was dismissed, demoted three ranks, and exiled to Nankang Army as Training Vice Commissioner of Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚午，薛叔似、陳謙罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Xue Shusi and Chen Qian were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Xue Shusi and Chen Qian were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以荊湖北路安撫使吳獵爲湖北、京西宣撫使。

translations.literal: Wu Lie, Hubei West Circuit Pacification Commissioner, was made Hubei-Jingxi Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei West Pacification Commissioner Wu Lie was appointed Hubei-Jingxi Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 復兩浙圍田，募兩淮流民耕種。

translations.literal: Polder fields in the two Zhe circuits were restored, and refugees from the two Huai circuits were recruited to cultivate them.
translations.idiomatic: Two Zhe polder fields were restored, and Two Huai refugees were recruited to farm them.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，吳曦始自稱蜀王。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Wu Xi first styled himself Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Wu Xi first declared himself Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以鎮江副都統畢再遇爲鎮江都統、權山東京東路招撫司公事。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Bi Zaiyu, deputy commander-in-chief of Zhenjiang, was made commander-in-chief of Zhenjiang and acting chief of the Shandong-Jingdong Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Zhenjiang Deputy Commander Bi Zaiyu became Zhenjiang Commander-in-Chief and acting chief of the Shandong-Jingdong Pacification Office.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，四川宣撫使程松遁。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Cheng Song, Sichuan Pacification Commissioner, fled.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Cheng Song fled.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁丑朔，丘崈罷。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, on the first day dingchou, Qiu Jun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of spring in the third year, dingchou, Qiu Jun was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命知樞密院事張岩督視江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Zhang Yan, Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to supervise Jiang and Huai military forces.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Bureau Director Zhang Yan was ordered to supervise Jiang and Huai forces.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以陳自強兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Chen Ziqiang was made concurrent Bureau Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Chen Ziqiang was also appointed Bureau Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸未，金人破階州。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Jin troops broke Jie Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Jin troops captured Jie Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，子圻生。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the son Qi was born.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the son Qi was born.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔建康府給淮民裝錢，遣歸業。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, an edict ordered Jiankang Prefecture to give travel money to Huai refugees and send them home to resume their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Jiankang Prefecture was ordered to give travel funds to Huai refugees and send them home to resume farming.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，吳曦招通判興元府、權大安軍事楊震仲，震仲不屈，死之。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Wu Xi summoned Yang Zhenzhong, Vice Prefect of Xingyuan Prefecture and acting military commissioner of Da'an; Zhenzhong refused to submit and was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Wu Xi summoned Yang Zhenzhong, vice prefect of Xingyuan and acting commissioner of Da'an military affairs; Zhenzhong refused to yield and was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命兩淮帥守、監司招集流民。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, commanders, prefects, and supervisory officials of the Two Huai circuits were ordered to gather displaced persons.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, military commanders, prefects, and circuit supervisors in the Two Huai regions were ordered to register displaced people.

sentences.zh: 甲午，吳曦僭位於興州。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Wu Xi arrogated the throne at Xing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Wu Xi declared himself ruler at Xing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，奪池州都統陳孝慶三官罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Chen Xiaoqing, Commander-in-Chief of Chizhou, was stripped of three ranks and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Chen Xiaoqing, commander-in-chief of Chizhou, was demoted three ranks and removed from office.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，以金師退，御正殿，復膳。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day renzi, because the Jin army had withdrawn, the emperor attended court in the main hall and resumed regular meals.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renzi, with the Jin forces withdrawn, the emperor held audience in the main hall and resumed normal dining.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，削奪福建路總管兼延祥水軍統制商榮官爵、柳州安置。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Shang Rong, Commissioner General of Fujian circuit and concurrently commander of the Yanxiang Naval Force, was stripped of rank and title and exiled to Liuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Shang Rong, Fujian circuit commissioner general and commander of the Yanxiang naval force, was stripped of rank and title and exiled to Liuzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，罷程松四川宣撫使，以成都府路安撫使楊輔爲四川制置使，沿江制置使葉適兼江、淮制置使。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Cheng Song was dismissed as Sichuan Pacification Commissioner; Yang Fu, Pacification Commissioner of Chengdu circuit, was made Sichuan Reorganization Commissioner; Ye Shi, Commissioner along the Yangzi, was also made Commissioner of the Jiang and Huai regions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Cheng Song was removed as Sichuan pacification commissioner; Yang Fu, pacification commissioner of Chengdu circuit, became Sichuan reorganization commissioner; and Ye Shi, Yangzi commissioner, was also made commissioner of the Jiang and Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以旱，詔大理、三衙、臨安府決系囚。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, owing to drought, an edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Palace Commands, and Lin'an Prefecture to adjudicate detained prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, owing to drought, the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Palace Commands, and Lin'an Prefecture were ordered to review detained prisoners.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，子圻薨，追封順王，諡沖懷。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the son Qi died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shun with the posthumous name Chonghuai.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the son Qi died; he was posthumously created Prince of Shun with the temple name Chonghuai.

sentences.zh: 甲子，振給旱傷州縣貧民。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, relief was distributed to the poor in drought-stricken prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, relief was issued to the poor in drought-stricken prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 命諸路提刑司從宜斷疑獄。

translations.literal: Judicial commissioners in all circuits were ordered to decide doubtful cases as circumstances warranted.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit judicial commissioners were ordered to decide doubtful cases as they saw fit.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，罷江、浙、荊湖、福建招軍。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, recruitment in Jiang, Zhe, Jing-Hu, and Fujian was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, military recruitment in Jiang, Zhe, Jing-Hu, and Fujian was suspended.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，子墌生。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the son Di was born.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the son Di was born.

sentences.zh: 庚午，金人去襄陽。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the Jin forces left Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the Jin army withdrew from Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以旱，禱於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, owing to drought, prayers were offered at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, owing to drought, the court prayed at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 命有司舉行寬恤之政八條，蠲兩淮被兵諸州今年租賦。

translations.literal: The relevant offices were ordered to implement eight policies of lenient relief and to remit this year's land tax in Huai circuits ravaged by war.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices were ordered to carry out eight leniency measures and remit this year's land tax in Huai prefectures ravaged by war.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，釋兩浙路杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, prisoners sentenced to beating or less in the Two Zhe circuit were released.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, prisoners in the Two Zhe circuit sentenced to beating or less were released.

sentences.zh: 四川宣撫副使司隨軍轉運安丙及興州中軍正將李好義、監四川總領所興州合江倉楊巨源等共誅吳曦，傳首詣行在，獻於廟社，梟三日，四川平。

translations.literal: An Bing, army transport commissioner attached to the Sichuan Deputy Pacification Commissioner's office, Li Haoyi, chief captain of the central army at Xing Prefecture, Yang Juyuan, overseer of the Hejiang granary at Xing Prefecture under the Sichuan General Supply Office, and others jointly executed Wu Xi; his head was sent to the temporary capital, presented at the ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain, and exposed for three days; Sichuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: An Bing, transport commissioner on the Sichuan deputy pacification staff, Li Haoyi, chief captain of Xing Prefecture's central army, Yang Juyuan, overseer of the Hejiang granary under the Sichuan supply office at Xing Prefecture, and others jointly killed Wu Xi; his head was sent to court, presented at the ancestral temple and state altars, and displayed for three days; Sichuan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 並誅曦妻子，家屬徙嶺南，奪其父挺官，遷吳璘子孫出蜀，存其廟祀，玠子孫免連坐。

translations.literal: Wu Xi's wife and children were also executed; his household dependents were exiled to Lingnan; his father Ting was stripped of office; the descendants of Wu Lin were removed from Sichuan; their ancestral worship was preserved; and the descendants of Wu Jie were exempted from collective punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xi's wife and children were also executed; his dependents were exiled to Lingnan; his father Ting was stripped of office; Wu Lin's descendants were removed from Sichuan while their ancestral rites were preserved; and Wu Jie's descendants were spared collective punishment.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子朔，蠲兩淮被兵州郡役錢。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day bingzi, corvée levies were remitted in Huai prefectures ravaged by war.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, bingzi, corvée payments were remitted in Huai prefectures ravaged by war.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，斬偽四川都轉運使徐景望於利州。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the false Sichuan Director of Transport Xu Jingwang was beheaded at Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Xu Jingwang, the rebel director of Sichuan transport, was beheaded at Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，興州將劉昌國引兵至階州，金人退去。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Liu Changguo, a general of Xing Prefecture, led troops to Jie Prefecture and the Jin forces withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Liu Changguo of Xing Prefecture led troops to Jie Prefecture, and the Jin army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，李好義復西和州。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Li Haoyi recovered Xihe Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Li Haoyi recaptured Xihe Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，金人去成州。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the Jin forces left Cheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the Jin army withdrew from Cheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔以楊輔爲四川宣撫使，安丙爲端明殿學士、四川宣撫副使，起居舍人許奕爲四川宣諭使。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, an edict appointed Yang Fu Sichuan Pacification Commissioner, An Bing Academician of the Duanming Hall and Deputy Pacification Commissioner of Sichuan, and Attendance Secretary Xu Yi Sichuan Pacification Envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Yang Fu was appointed Sichuan pacification commissioner, An Bing made academician of the Duanming Hall and deputy pacification commissioner of Sichuan, and attendance secretary Xu Yi Sichuan pacification envoy.

sentences.zh: 落程松資政殿大學士，奪六官、筠州安置。

translations.literal: Cheng Song was removed from his post as Grand Academician of the Zizheng Hall, stripped of six ranks, and exiled to Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Song was stripped of his grand academician title in the Zizheng Hall, demoted six ranks, and exiled to Yun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 忠義統領張翼復鳳州。

translations.literal: Zhang Yi, commander of the Loyalty and Righteousness forces, recovered Feng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yi, commander of the loyalist forces, recaptured Feng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，曲赦四川，減雜犯死罪囚，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, a partial amnesty was granted in Sichuan; prisoners guilty of miscellaneous capital offenses had their sentences reduced, and those sentenced to beating or less were released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Sichuan received a partial amnesty: capital sentences for miscellaneous offenses were commuted, and prisoners sentenced to beating or less were released.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，責授程松順昌軍節度副使、澧州安置。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Cheng Song was demoted to Military Vice Commissioner of Shunchang Army and exiled to Li Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Cheng Song was demoted to military vice commissioner of Shunchang Army and exiled to Li Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，以吳獵兼四川宣諭使。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day wushen, Wu Lie was also made Sichuan Pacification Envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wushen, Wu Lie was also appointed Sichuan pacification envoy.

sentences.zh: 子墌薨，追封申王，諡沖懿。

translations.literal: The son Di died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shen with the posthumous name Chongyi.
translations.idiomatic: The son Di died; he was posthumously created Prince of Shen with the temple name Chongyi.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，赦兩淮、湖北、京西被兵諸州，減雜犯死罪囚，釋流以下。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, amnesty was granted in Huai, Hubei, and Jingxi prefectures ravaged by war; prisoners guilty of miscellaneous capital offenses had their sentences reduced, and those sentenced to exile or less were released.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Huai, Hubei, and Jingxi prefectures ravaged by war received amnesty: capital sentences for miscellaneous offenses were commuted, and prisoners sentenced to exile or less were released.

sentences.zh: 蠲湖北、京西諸郡今年租賦。

translations.literal: This year's land tax was remitted in the various prefectures of Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: This year's land tax was remitted in Hubei and Jingxi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 四川忠義人復大散關。

translations.literal: Loyalists in Sichuan recovered Dasanguan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan loyalist forces recaptured Dasanguan Pass.

sentences.zh: 己未，奉使金國通謝、國信所參議官方信孺發行在。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Fang Xinru, deliberator of the Office of Credentials for the mission of gratitude to the Jin state, departed from the temporary capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Fang Xinru, deliberator on the Jin gratitude mission of the Office of Credentials, departed from court.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以兵部尚書宇文紹節知江陵府，權湖北、京西宣撫使。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Yuwen Shaojie, Minister of War, was made prefect of Jiangling and acting Pacification Commissioner of Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Minister of War Yuwen Shaojie was appointed prefect of Jiangling and acting pacification commissioner of Hubei and Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔吳獵與宣撫司議，分興州都統司軍之半屯利州。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, an edict ordered Wu Lie to consult with the Pacification Commission and station half the troops of the Xing Prefecture Commander-in-Chief's headquarters at Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Wu Lie was ordered to consult the pacification commission and station half the Xing Prefecture command's troops at Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，召楊輔詣行在，以吳獵爲四川制置使。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Yang Fu was summoned to the temporary capital and Wu Lie was made Sichuan Reorganization Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Yang Fu was summoned to court and Wu Lie was appointed Sichuan reorganization commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以資政殿學士錢象祖參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Qian Xiangzu, Academician of the Zizheng Hall, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Qian Xiangzu, academician of the Zizheng Hall, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 己巳，改興州爲沔州。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Xing Prefecture was renamed Min Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Xing Prefecture was renamed Min Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚午，贈楊震仲官，仍官其子一人。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, posthumous rank was granted to Yang Zhenzhong, and one of his sons was given office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Yang Zhenzhong was posthumously honored with office, and one of his sons was given an official post.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，金人復破大散關。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the Jin forces again captured Dasanguan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the Jin army again captured Dasanguan Pass.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，赦西和、階、成、鳳四州。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, amnesty was granted in the four prefectures of Xihe, Jie, Cheng, and Feng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, amnesty was granted in Xihe, Jie, Cheng, and Feng prefectures.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，賞誅吳曦功。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingchou, rewards were granted for the merit of executing Wu Xi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingchou, rewards were issued for killing Wu Xi.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，用四川宣撫司奏，吳曦党人張伸之等一十六人除名，編配兩廣及湖南諸州。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, acting on a memorial from the Sichuan Pacification Commission, Zhang Shenzhi and fifteen other associates of Wu Xi were struck from the roster and registered for exile to Guang and Hunan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, on a memorial from the Sichuan pacification commission, Zhang Shenzhi and fifteen other Wu Xi associates were expelled from office and exiled to Guang and Hunan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以旱，禱於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, owing to drought, prayers were offered at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, owing to drought, the court prayed at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以太皇太后謝氏有疾，赦，是日崩。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, because Grand Empress Dowager Xie was ill, an amnesty was granted; on that same day she died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, an amnesty was proclaimed because Grand Empress Dowager Xie was ill; she died that same day.

sentences.zh: 四川宣撫副使司參贊軍事楊巨源與金人戰於長橋，敗績。

translations.literal: Yang Juyuan, staff officer on military affairs of the Sichuan Deputy Pacification Commissioner's office, fought the Jin at Changqiao and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Juyuan, military staff officer on the Sichuan deputy pacification commission, fought the Jin at Changqiao and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔四川宣撫、制置司分治兵民。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, an edict ordered the Sichuan Pacification and Reorganization commissions to divide civil and military administration.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the Sichuan pacification and reorganization commissions were ordered to divide military and civilian administration.

sentences.zh: 庚子，復置沔州副都統制，以李好義爲之。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the post of Deputy Commander-in-Chief of Min Prefecture was reestablished, with Li Haoyi appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the deputy commander-in-chief of Min Prefecture was reinstated, with Li Haoyi appointed to the post.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，李好義襲秦州，敗還。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Li Haoyi raided Qin Prefecture and returned defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Li Haoyi raided Qin Prefecture but was driven back in defeat.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，賞守襄陽功。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiayin, rewards were granted for the merit of defending Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiayin, rewards were issued for defending Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 己未，李好義遇毒死。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Li Haoyi died by poison.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Li Haoyi died of poisoning.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以林拱辰爲金國通謝使，遣富琯使金告哀，劉彌正賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Lin Gongchen was made envoy of gratitude to the Jin state; Fu Guan was dispatched to Jin to announce mourning; Liu Mizheng was sent to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Lin Gongchen was appointed Jin gratitude envoy; Fu Guan was sent to Jin to announce mourning; and Liu Mizheng was sent to congratulate the Jin emperor on his birthday.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，安丙殺其參議官楊巨源。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, An Bing killed his deliberator Yang Juyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, An Bing killed his deliberator Yang Juyuan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，命不儔爲嗣濮王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jimao, Bu Chou was appointed heir to the Princely House of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jimao, Bu Chou was appointed heir to the House of Pu.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以災傷，下詔罪己。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, owing to disaster and hardship, an edict of self-reproach was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, owing to disaster and hardship, the emperor issued an edict blaming himself.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，上大行太皇太后諡曰成肅皇后。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jisi, the late Grand Empress Dowager was given the posthumous title Empress Chengsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi, the late grand empress dowager was given the posthumous title Empress Chengsu.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，詔諸路帥臣申儆邊備。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day dingchou, an edict ordered military commanders in all circuits to report on frontier preparedness.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingchou, circuit commanders were ordered to report on frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，召張岩詣行在。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Zhang Yan was summoned to the temporary capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Zhang Yan was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 壬午，方信孺以忤韓侂胄，坐用私覿物擅作大臣饋遺金將，奪三官、臨江軍居住。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Fang Xinru, for offending Han Tuozhou, was punished for using private-audience gifts to present, on his own authority, ministerial gifts to Jin generals; three ranks were stripped from him and he was confined to Linjiang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Fang Xinru was punished for offending Han Tuozhou by using private-audience gifts to present ministerial gifts to Jin generals without authorization; he was demoted three ranks and confined to Linjiang Army.

sentences.zh: 甲申，減極邊官吏舉主員。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the quota of examination sponsors for officials on the outermost frontier was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the quota of civil-service sponsors for officials on the outermost frontier was reduced.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，權欑成肅皇后于永阜陵。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Empress Chengsu was provisionally interred at Yongfu Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Empress Chengsu was provisionally interred at Yongfu Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命淮西轉運司措置雄淮軍。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the Huai West Transport Commission was ordered to organize the Xionghuai Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Huai West transport commission was ordered to organize the Xionghuai Army.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以趙淳爲殿前副都指揮使兼江、淮制置使。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Zhao Chun was made Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Army and concurrently Commissioner of the Jiang and Huai regions.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Zhao Chun was appointed deputy commander-in-chief of the Palace Army and commissioner of the Jiang and Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 乙未，張岩罷。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Zhang Yan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Zhang Yan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣王柟持書赴金國都副元帥府。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Wang Nan was dispatched with a letter to the Jin Deputy Marshal's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Wang Nan was sent with a letter to the Jin deputy marshal's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，祔成肅皇后神主于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the spirit tablet of Empress Chengsu was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Empress Chengsu's spirit tablet was installed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，減臨安、紹興二府囚罪一等，蠲民緣欑宮役者賦。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day yisi, sentences of prisoners in Lin'an and Shaoxing prefectures were reduced one degree, and taxes were remitted for commoners levied for service at the temporary palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yisi, sentences in Lin'an and Shaoxing were reduced one degree, and taxes were remitted for commoners conscripted for service at the temporary palace.

sentences.zh: 丙午，更殿前司純隊法。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the Palace Army's Chundui regulations were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the Palace Army's Chundui regulations were revised.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，復珍州遵義軍。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Zunyi Army in Zhen Prefecture was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Zunyi Army in Zhen Prefecture was restored.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔以邊事諭軍民。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict announced frontier affairs to the army and people.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, an edict announced frontier affairs to soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，詔：韓侂胄輕啟兵端，罷平章軍國事；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jiaxu, an edict declared: Han Tuozhou rashly opened hostilities and was removed as Director of State Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiaxu, an edict declared: Han Tuozhou had rashly opened hostilities and was removed as director of state affairs;

sentences.zh: 陳自強阿附充位，罷右丞相。

translations.literal: Chen Ziqiang had fawned on power and merely filled a post and was removed as Chief Councilor of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ziqiang had fawned on power and merely filled a post and was removed as right chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，禮部侍郎史彌遠等以密旨命權主管殿前司公事夏震誅韓侂胄於玉津園。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Shi Miyuan, Vice Minister of Rites, and others, by secret imperial order, directed Xia Zhen, acting chief of Palace Army affairs, to execute Han Tuozhou in Yujin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Vice Minister of Rites Shi Miyuan and others, by secret order, directed acting Palace Army chief Xia Zhen to kill Han Tuozhou in Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 以錢象祖兼知樞密院事，李壁兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Qian Xiangzu was made concurrent Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Li Bi concurrent Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Xiangzu was made concurrent director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Li Bi concurrent vice director.

sentences.zh: 以誅韓侂胄詔天下。

translations.literal: An edict announcing the execution of Han Tuozhou was issued throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: An edict announcing Han Tuozhou's execution was proclaimed empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以夏震爲福州觀察使、主管殿前司公事，將士行賞有差。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Xia Zhen was made Observation Commissioner of Fuzhou and chief of Palace Army affairs; soldiers and officers received graded rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Xia Zhen was made observation commissioner of Fuzhou and chief of Palace Army affairs; officers and soldiers received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 奪陳自強三官、永州居住。

translations.literal: Three ranks were stripped from Chen Ziqiang and he was confined to Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ziqiang was demoted three ranks and confined to Yong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，責授蘇師旦武泰軍節度副使、韶州安置；

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Su Shidan was demoted to Military Vice Commissioner of Wutai Army and exiled to Shao Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Su Shidan was demoted to military vice commissioner of Wutai Army and exiled to Shao Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 己卯，斬之。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, he was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, he was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 詔：「奸臣竄殛，當首開言路，以來忠讜。

translations.literal: An edict declared: "With treacherous ministers executed and exiled, the court should above all open the avenues of speech to invite loyal remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "With treacherous ministers executed and exiled, the court should above all open the avenues of speech to invite loyal remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 中外臣僚，各具所見以聞。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials within and without should each present their views for report."
translations.idiomatic: Officials at court and in the provinces should each present their views for the throne's consideration."

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，再奪鄧友龍五官、南雄州安置，尋除名，徙循州。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, five more ranks were stripped from Deng Youlong and he was exiled to Nanxiong Prefecture; shortly afterward he was struck from the roster and transferred to Xun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Deng Youlong was demoted five more ranks and exiled to Nanxiong Prefecture; shortly afterward he was expelled from office and transferred to Xun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，置御前忠銳軍。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the Imperial Loyal and Sharp Army was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the Imperial Loyal and Sharp Army was established.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以御史中丞衛涇簽書樞密院事兼參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Wei Jing, Censor-in-Chief, was made Concurrent Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Censor-in-Chief Wei Jing was appointed concurrent signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs and vice director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔立皇子榮王曮爲皇太子，更名懤。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict established the emperor's son, Prince Yan of Rong, as crown prince and renamed him Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Prince Yan of Rong was established as crown prince and renamed Yi.

sentences.zh: 戊子，郭倪除名、梅州安置，郭僎除名，連州安置：仍籍其家。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Guo Ni was struck from the roster and exiled to Mei Prefecture; Guo Zun was struck from the roster and exiled to Lian Prefecture; their households were still registered for confiscation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Guo Ni was expelled from office and exiled to Mei Prefecture; Guo Zun was expelled from office and exiled to Lian Prefecture; their households were registered for confiscation.

sentences.zh: 奪李壁三官、撫州居住。

translations.literal: Three ranks were stripped from Li Bi and he was confined to Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bi was demoted three ranks and confined to Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，奪張岩二官、徽州居住。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, two ranks were stripped from Zhang Yan and he was confined to Hui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Zhang Yan was demoted two ranks and confined to Hui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以立皇太子，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, a general amnesty was proclaimed for the establishment of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, a general amnesty was proclaimed for the establishment of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，以丘崈爲江、淮制置大使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day guimao, Qiu Yue was made Grand Commissioner of the Jiang and Huai regions.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guimao, Qiu Yue was appointed grand commissioner of the Jiang and Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 罷山東、京東招撫司。

translations.literal: The Pacification Commissions of Shandong and Jingdong were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Shandong and Jingdong pacification commissions were abolished.

sentences.zh: 以許奕爲金國通問使。

translations.literal: Xu Yi was made envoy to inquire of the Jin state.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yi was appointed Jin inquiry envoy.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁未，罷京西北路招撫司。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the Pacification Commission of Jingxi North circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Jingxi North pacification commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己酉，落葉適寶文閣待制。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Ye Shi was removed from his post as Attendant Gentleman of the Baowen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Ye Shi was removed from his post as attendant gentleman of the Baowen Hall.

sentences.zh: 蠲兩淮州軍稅一年。

translations.literal: Taxes were remitted for one year in Huai prefectures and armies.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes were remitted for one year in Huai prefectures and military districts.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，奪許及之二官、泉州居住。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, two ranks were stripped from Xu Jizhi and he was confined to Quan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Xu Jizhi was demoted two ranks and confined to Quan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 奪薛叔似二官、福州居住。

translations.literal: Two ranks were stripped from Xue Shusi and he was confined to Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Shusi was demoted two ranks and confined to Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 再奪皇甫斌五官、英德府安置。

translations.literal: Five more ranks were stripped from Huangfu Bin and he was exiled to Yingde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Bin was demoted five more ranks and exiled to Yingde Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，金人復破隨州。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Jin forces again captured Sui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the Jin army again captured Sui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以錢象祖爲右丞相兼樞密使，衛涇及給事中雷孝友並參知政事，吏部尚書林大中簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Qian Xiangzu was made Chief Councilor of the Right and concurrent Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Wei Jing and Supervising Secretary Lei Xiaoyou were both made Vice Directors of the Secretariat-Chancellery; and Lin Dazhong, Minister of Personnel, was made Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Qian Xiangzu was appointed right chief councilor and concurrent commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Wei Jing and supervising secretary Lei Xiaoyou were both made vice directors of the Secretariat-Chancellery; and Minister of Personnel Lin Dazhong was made signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以禮部尚書史彌遠同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Shi Miyuan, Minister of Rites, was made Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Minister of Rites Shi Miyuan was appointed vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，贈呂祖儉朝奉郎、直秘閣，官其子一人。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Lü Zujian was posthumously granted the rank of Gentleman for Court Audience and Compiler in the Hall of Secrets, and one of his sons was given office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Lü Zujian was posthumously honored as gentleman for court audience and compiler in the Hall of Secrets, and one of his sons was given an official post.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔改明年爲嘉定元年。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, an edict changed the following year to the first year of Jiading.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, an edict proclaimed that the following year would be the first year of Jiading.

sentences.zh: 是歲，浙西旱蝗，沿江諸州水。

translations.literal: That year, western Zhe suffered drought and locusts, and prefectures along the Yangzi suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That year, western Zhe suffered drought and locusts, while prefectures along the Yangzi were inundated.
